CE-MAT-001.problem: Reviewed model output was not connected to complete, immutable, hash-bound source partitions with explicit source scope.

CE-MAT-002.problem: Missing/hash-mismatched source material or invalid citation coordinates must not be accepted as trusted source text or attributed to patient quality.

CE-MAT-003.problem: Unknown, null, proxy-only or unverified availability must never become KEEP permission.

CE-MAT-004.problem: Conflicting KEEP/MASK proposals require REVIEW rather than arbitrary clipping or precedence.

CE-MAT-005.problem: Mechanically complete partitions must not bypass independent semantic assessment or become doctor packets.

CE-MAT-006.problem: AI-assisted reading drafts must not be relabelled as independent human semantic review, and unresolved segments or source coverage cannot grant doctor-packet release.
counterexamples: A PENDING draft has research_preparation as its reviewer type, no independence attestation, and unresolved coverage.
A proposed MASK remains subject to independent review; other spans remain REVIEW after deterministic recompilation.
controls: Draft metadata and exact source/span bindings validate without becoming a semantic PASS.
Changing preparation status or asserting independence is rejected; existing files are never overwritten.
